artworks.title: Venus in a Garden with Cupids
artworks.description: This is an image of cherubs in a forested landscape. The cherubs are engaging in various playful activities amidst the trees and foliage. They are climbing trees, flying, reclining on the ground, and interacting with each other in a lively environment. The forest is lush, with detailed leaves and branches. The cherubs are intricately rendered, showcasing a sense of movement and joy. The background includes distant hills, adding depth to the composition. The scene captures a sense of innocence and delight in a natural setting.

artworks.title: Young Woman, Surrounded by Cupids (The Garden of Charity, vertical version)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple chubby, cherub-like figures surrounding a large tree. The scene consists of cherubic infants, some emerging from the tree's dense foliage, while others are on or near the ground. The figures are in various playful and serene poses. The drawing shows a whimsical, idyllic setting with a tranquil, natural landscape in the background. The line work emphasizes the patterns of the tree bark and leaves, which envelop the cherubs in light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in dramatic poses carrying a limp figure from the ground. The drawing depicts a scene with multiple figures dressed in flowing garments, concentrating on the central act of lifting or carrying another figure. The figures are rendered in bold lines, emphasizing form and movement. Their expressions and postures convey a sense of solemnity and urgency. In the background, a large tree and drapery create a sense of depth and atmosphere. The artwork is full of intricate linework and shading, which adds texture and a dynamic quality to the composition. The scene is evocative, inviting viewers to contemplate the story behind the moment captured.

artworks.title: Baigneuses luttant (Bathers Wrestling)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a natural setting. The image depicts several nude figures near a body of water. The figures are arranged in a composition, suggesting movement and interaction. The background is filled with foliage. The use of light and shadow, as well as the rendering of the figures’ forms, create a sense of vibrancy and life in the drawing.

artworks.title: Peasants in a Field of Beans (Paysannes dans un champ de haricots)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a field bending over. The figures are shown in a crouched posture, seemingly picking or gathering something from the ground. The background features a flat agricultural landscape with a distant horizon line and rises of land that could represent haystacks or hills. The shading and hatched lines create depth and suggest the folds of the figures' clothing. The texture appears rough, conveying a sense of the earthy surface they are interacting with. The composition focuses on labor in a rural setting.

artworks.title: Boy Delivering a Letter to a Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts three people in a baroque-styled setting. On the left, a man holds his hat and gestures towards the seated woman. The seated woman wears a gown and has curly hair, while the woman on the right also has curly hair and holds a piece of jewelry. A small dog stands beneath the man. The room is ornate with heavy drapery, a landscape view, and various furnishings.

artworks.title: A Storm
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene from a slightly elevated perspective. A thatched structure is in the background on the right. Close to us, a partially nude figure is embracing another figure near a resting cow, with another cow in the shadows. The figures are detailed with intricate line work using fine hatching for texture and depth. A herd of cattle is seen resting and grazing in the grassy area on the left. The landscape extends into the distance with trees under a large tree's branches. The image has a monochromatic palette with dense black and white lines emphasizing textures and forms within the composition.

artworks.title: The Sleeping Boy
artworks.description: The image shows five people and a dog in a domestic setting. In the center, a young woman in a gown and with loose hair sits on steps with her eyes closed. An elderly woman holds her hand, and another woman leans on her shoulder. A couple is seated behind them, with the woman kissing the man's cheek. A black and white dog is lying on the floor, and elaborate curtains hang in the background.

artworks.title: The Bodies of Saints Peter and Paul Hidden in the Catacombs
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.9 x 20.6 cm (11 3/4 x 8 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sleeping figure and figures nearby in a wooded landscape. The scene is intricately detailed with cross-hatching and line work. A figure is depicted reclining in a forest-like setting beneath a canopy of dense foliage. To the right, a group of figures can be seen clustered together with their expressions subtly etched into the background of trees and shadows. The composition uses dark and light areas to direct attention towards the sleeping figure, which is illuminated. The atmosphere conveyed is one of a moment captured in a forested or natural setting.

artworks.title: Circe Changing Ulysses' Men into Beasts
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.1 x 31.1 cm (8 11/16 x 12 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a seated figure surrounded by scattered papers, scrolls, books, animals including sheep, a dog, a deer, and a peacock. The background consists of a rustic stone wall with archways and foliage. The overall atmosphere is serene and contemplative.

artworks.title: Rachel Concealing Laban's Idols
artworks.description: This image shows figures gathered under trees with animals, set against a backdrop of mountains. The scene depicts individuals engaged in various activities under the trees, along with horses and sheep. In the background are distant mountains, with clouds in the sky. The detailed etching uses line work to depict the forms of the figures, animals, and natural environment.

artworks.title: The Resurrection of Lazarus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.6 x 31.7 cm (8 7/8 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting figures gathered around a central stone structure. There is a reclining figure near the stone formation. Another figure stands with an arm raised in the right portion of the image. The characters display expressions of concern or awe. The stone structure and surrounding vegetation are detailed with textured lines.

artworks.title: Tobit Burying the Dead
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.8 x 30.2 cm (8 3/16 x 11 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures engaged in various tasks in an outdoor setting with a rough, shadowy background. The scene captures a range of actions and features figures in different postures and attire, suggesting movement and engagement in laborious activities. The composition is dense with intricate lines, creating a textured appearance throughout the scene. Light and shadow play a significant role, highlighting the figures and giving depth to the background. The drawing's style is detailed, with emphasis on form through the use of hatching and cross-hatching techniques.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 44.1 x 31.5 cm (17 3/8 x 12 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One figure is standing, while the other is kneeling. The standing person has one hand raised to chest level and the other hand slightly extended forward, facing the kneeling figure. They have delicate facial features, with closed eyes and curly hair adorned with a halo. They are dressed in flowing robes with a hood lying on their back. The kneeling figure is holding a lily with one hand and extending the other hand towards the standing person. They also have curly hair and a halo, with wings emerging from their back. They are dressed in a draped garment. A small cat is curled up on the floor beside them. In the background, there is a window showing a distant, large building with turrets and a landscape beyond, with heavy drapery partially framing the window above the figures.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William T. Hassett, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a young man facing the viewer with a slight turn to his right. He has youthful facial features, smooth skin, straight eyebrows, and a small nose. His hair is neatly combed to the side, with a slight wave, reaching just above his ears. The man is wearing formal clothing, including a dark jacket, a high-collared white shirt, and a dark cravat or bow tie. The background is a plain, monochromatic surface.

artworks.title: Excalftoria minima (Blue-breasted Quail)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This painting shows three small birds in a natural setting. Two birds have blue and brown plumage, while the third bird has uniformly brown and speckled feathers. The birds are situated in an area with grass and bare earth. The setting includes grass blades and other flora under a clear sky. The style is similar to John Gould's detailed ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Perdix barbata (Daurian Partridge)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This image shows two birds in a natural setting. Two partridges are depicted on the ground, with one standing and the other sitting in grass. The birds have detailed plumage in earth tones such as brown, orange, and subtle blues. One bird has a blue chest patch. The painting conveys a serene and naturalistic atmosphere, with the birds displaying expressive eyes and intricate patterns on their backs. The background shows a softly tinted sky and grass. The style resembles 19th-century naturalist illustrations, possibly similar to John Gould's works.

artworks.title: Turdus Poecilopterus (Aztec Thrush)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds standing on a rocky surface. The drawing features two birds perched on a naturalistic, rocky terrain with some plants and foliage in monochrome style. The bottom bird has black plumage and an orange beak. The top bird has brown and grey tones. Both birds are detailed with feathering, leg posture, and eyes, despite the minimalistic background.

artworks.title: Drepanornis albertisi (Black-billed Sicklebill Bird of Paradise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on a branch. The birds have vibrant plumage; the first bird is black, red, and iridescent teal with an elongated tail and curved beak. The second bird is brown with subtle patterns. The branch has green leaves and white and yellow flowers. This is in the style of John Gould.

artworks.title: Hypsipetes Psaroides (Black Bulbul)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Hypsipetes psaroides bird perched on a branch. The drawing features a depiction of the bird with its slate-gray body, black crest, and bright red beak and legs standing out against a light background. The bird's feathers are illustrated, showing patterns and textures. It perches on a slender branch that appears to be part of a leafless bush or tree. The scientific name "Hypsipetes psaroides" is inscribed below the bird. The drawing combines detailed and sketchy elements, resembling a classical scientific illustration.

artworks.title: Petrocossyphus cyanus (Blue Rockthrush)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on a rock. One bird is predominantly blue with vivid feather details, standing on the right side of the rock. The other bird, on the left, has brown and grey feathers with darker streaks. Both birds are depicted with precision, showcasing variations in their plumage. The setting includes grassy terrain and rocky formations, suggesting a natural habitat. The background has softly blended, pale colors, enhancing the focus on the birds themselves. It is in the style of John Gould.

artworks.title: Accentor modularis (Dunnock)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two small birds perched on a tree branch. The birds have brown and grey feathers and appear calm. The branch has green leaves and a red mushroom growing from the side. The background has soft, neutral tones.

artworks.title: Ligurinus chloris (Greenfinch)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of birds perched on a branch with a nest. It features two small birds with green and yellow plumage on a leafy branch with red and white flowers. In the nest, there are several young chicks with wide eyes and small beaks peeking out. The background is plain, emphasizing the details of the birds and foliage. The style is similar to John Gould's ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Enicurus Scouleri (Little Forktail)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird standing on the ground in a side profile view. The bird has black and white feathers, with a black head, back, and wings, a white band across the wings, a white rump, an elongated tail, and a slender bill. The legs are golden. The background is lightly sketched. The species name 'Enicurus Scouleri' is inscribed at the bottom. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon.
